text: Serving on the Diamond Bar City Council has been the honor of my life. It has deepened my understanding of what matters most to our residents: quality of life, safe neighborhoods, responsible government, and a prosperous future. I am running to build on that work with proven leadership and a clear vision.

My commitment rests on four priorities. First, safety comes first. I will support well-staffed and equipped law enforcement and rapid emergency response so families feel protected on every street, park, and school.
Second, I will guard your tax dollars with discipline. Long-term stability comes from responsible budgeting, not from raising taxes on hardworking families and small businesses.
Third, a thriving local economy fuels our quality of life. I want Diamond Bar to be a place where small businesses flourish, and entrepreneurs feel welcome.
Fourth, protecting our environment safeguards our health and future. I will work to preserve the green spaces and natural beauty that make our city special.

Each of these priorities reinforces the other; together they create a Diamond Bar that is safe, financially sound, and vibrant. I would be honored to earn your vote. Join me in building a stronger Diamond Bar for generations to come.

text: I am proud to be a long-time Diamond Bar resident, small business owner, and dedicated community volunteer. My wife and I moved here in 1993, where we raised our daughter and built our life in this wonderful city.

For over 30 years, I have owned and operated a business, giving me real world experience in budgeting, financial responsibility, and problem solving skills that are especially important as Diamond Bar faces ongoing fiscal challenges.

I currently serve as a Planning Commissioner and have also served on the Parks and Recreation Commission, providing hands-on experience in land use, community services, and city operations. I am also actively involved with the Diamond Bar Friends of the Library, Diamond Bar Community Foundation, and Local service organizations.
I am running for City Council to bring strong fiscal responsibility, ensure public safety, improve traffic flow, and promote a healthy, active community.

I am committed to fighting for you-listening to residents, making thoughtful decisions, and putting our community first. I respectfully ask for your vote so we can keep Diamond Bar a safe, vibrant, and thriving place to live.
